name: Merge Build Artifacts
description: Merge one or more build Artifacts

name.description: The name of the artifact that the artifacts will be merged into.

pattern.description: A glob pattern matching the artifact names that should be merged.

separate-directories.description: When multiple artifacts are matched, this changes the behavior of how they are merged in the archive. If true, the matched artifacts will be extracted into indi

retention-days.description:
Duration after which artifact will expire in days. 0 means using default retention.
Minimum 1 day. Maximum 90 days unless changed from the repository settings p

compression-level.description: The level of compression for Zlib to be applied to the artifact archive. The value can range from 0 to 9: - 0: No compression - 1: Best speed - 6: Default compr

delete-merged.description: If true, the artifacts that were merged will be deleted. If false, the artifacts will still exist.

include-hidden-files.description: If true, hidden files will be included in the merged artifact. If false, hidden files will be excluded from the merged artifact.
